entries.notes: Amendment to CLAUDE.md §5: upgrade policy_guard language to reflect hook-based enforcement. Authorized by user instruction (add hooks wherever needed).

Expand security.yaml file_access.write.allowed to cover legitimate dev paths (tools/, core/, commands/, hooks/, runtime.md, USAGE.md, settings.json). Tier 4 amendment; hooks revealed the incomplete allowlist.

entries.detail: Integrated security-guidance/security_reminder_hook.py (9 content-level vuln patterns) as PreToolUse(Write|Edit|MultiEdit) hook. Windows-portable tempdir fix + AGENTIC_OS_HOOKS_DISABLED guard applied. Registered in tool_registry. Baseline repo scan clean.
v5.5: constitution diet (725->200 lines), orchestrator retired, Agent Teams enabled, acceptEdits default, Council formalized.

Council session: Q1 KEEP simulation_history/world_model/architecture_optimizer (defer to v6). Q2 APPROVED parallel-code-review team config. Q3 NO frontmatter changes. Infrastructure: nightly_improvement.py scheduled daily 16:03 local.

All 15 hook command invocations in settings.json rewritten to use $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR prefix. Root cause: relative paths (python .claude/hooks/X.py) failed when CWD drifted outside repo root during case-study run, creating self-inflicted lockout (hooks blocked all Bash/Write/Edit, preventing their own repair). Fix applied by user from terminal (main session was deadlocked).
entries.lesson: Hook command paths MUST be CWD-independent. Codified as regression check 42 and rule in .claude/rules/hooks.md.

entries.detail: Nightly improvement routine migrated from session-only CronCreate to persistent mcp__scheduled-tasks. Task file at ~/.claude/scheduled-tasks/agentic-os-nightly-improvement/SKILL.md. Schedule: daily 16:03 local (MCP adds ~8min deterministic jitter). Survives Claude Code restarts. Kill switch: AGENTIC_OS_NIGHTLY_DISABLED=1.
v5.7: Planning Council + /lead-agent mandatory entry; Ship Council veto narrowed to SPEC violation / new info / missed security
v5.7 correction: Ship Council post-exec veto scope restored to full v5.5 powers. Planning Council reduces loop-back frequency, not veto scope.

entries.notes: Nightly improvement run: 7 official docs fetched (out of 32; MCP SSL errors), 12 of 34 searches run. Applied hooks.md (new lifecycle events + handler types) and agents.md (new frontmatter fields). CLAUDE.md patches queued as PENDING_COUNCIL_DECISION per constitution rule.
